name: dirty-set-probe-scope
body: Two limits on this e2e. (1) The dirty-set probe asks each label `MATCH (n:<label>) WHERE n.updated = 1` and skips any label whose read refuses at bind time, so a durable node table that lost its `updated` column — or a newly added one — would go unmeasured by the empty-set assertions; upgrade when phase 2's `ArtifactDb::dirty_node_files_from_db` exposes the dirty roster through the production API and the per-label probe can be replaced. (2) This test pins the marking mechanism over the real database by driving the change builders and `mark_dirty` directly, not the admission; the admission's own `mark_dirty(&change.writes)` call is pinned separately by the routed positive assertions phase-1 task-15 added to `session_rm_of_a_saved_node_that_was_updated_leaves_no_file_and_one_commit` (the updated identity reads `updated = 1`, its untouched neighbour `0`, read through the live session before the save), so keep the two in step if either test is rewritten.
